title: Canon of the Twin Deeps
summary: A canon on pressing two columns of deep water qi together until the pressure crushes a guard and the body behind it.

title: Treatise of the Paired Brine
summary: A treatise on salt-heavy water qi worn on both hands that bites wounds clean and seals a foe's qi paths shut.

title: The Azure Fathom Mastery
summary: A mastery of measured depth in which each strike is weighed by the fathom of water qi stacked behind it.

title: Manual of the Dual-Track Maelstrom
summary: A manual of spinning two opposed whirls of water qi at once so one draws the foe in and the other grinds.

title: The Hawk-Dive Surf Treatise
summary: A treatise on diving through breaking surf with the hawk's drop and rising from it with a blow already loosed.

title: Canon of the Twin-Court Confluence
summary: A canon on joining two streams of water qi at one point so they heal the fallen and break the standing.

title: The Wind-Sworn Spate Canon
summary: A canon of the sudden spate that a wind-sworn student calls up at a sworn word and sends along the bearing.

title: Treatise of the Bearing Riptide
summary: A treatise on the pull beneath a calm surface that drags a held bearing through the opponent's footing.

title: The Oath of the Hidden Undercurrent
summary: A sworn manual of the current that runs unseen beneath a plain stance and drains the foe's qi before the blow.

title: Canon of the Open Spindrift
summary: A canon of wind-torn spray flung wide in the open with no cover and carried by the same wind that tore it.

title: The Plateau Downpour Manual
summary: A manual of the hammering downpour called down on the open plateau to soak the foe and wash the wounded clean.

title: The Bearing Aquifer Compendium
summary: A compendium on drawing from the deep stored water qi below a stance and sharing the draw with allies.
